svg.title: Multimodal Movement Learning: complete NinaPro DB2 E1 five-notebook study
svg.desc: Editable five-band scientific overview covering source audit in Notebook 01, paired windows and participant partitions in Notebook 02, unimodal Development models in Notebook 03, fusion Development models and frozen selection in Notebook 04, and independent five-person Test in Notebook 05. Bar lengths use saved participant-mean fixed-18-class Macro F1 values. Forearm illustration is schematic.

g.text: MULTIMODAL MOVEMENT LEARNING | NINAPRO DB2 E1
Five executed notebooks · paired sEMG and acceleration · Development model choice · five-person held-out Test

g.aria-label: Generic forearm and hand illustrating original wearable sensor data

g.text: Schematic forearm only; bar lengths use saved participant-mean Macro F1, not pooled-window accuracy. Test includes five people.
Source audit → paired E1 cohort → unimodal Development → multimodal fusion selection → frozen five-person Test evidence
